status: Filed BEFORE any Phase-2 policy was trained and before any Phase-2 cell existed. Additive: the parent is not rewritten. No decision rule, threshold, endpoint, arm definition or prediction is changed. The parent's own amendment_rule requires this record because a pinned code file changed.

corrections.reason: Refuse consolidation_fraction > 0 on the gate and ramp modes. Consolidation pins every cohort at lambda = 1.0 for the final stretch of training; for an arm whose frontier ends at 1.5 that is a support CONTRACTION, applied silently and invisible to the gate's incident log because the gate never requested it. It would have falsified the arm's central safety claim with nothing in the telemetry to show it.
corrections.behavioural_effect_on_phase_2: NONE. Neither gate_150 nor ramp_150 sets consolidation_fraction; the launcher passes it for no expansion arm. The change converts an unreachable-but-latent hazard into a construction-time refusal. Every other code path is byte-identical.

corrections.target: test environment claim in three commit messages of 2026-09-01
corrections.defect: Commits 637af48, dd11422 and c501ad6 describe 4 failures in test_analyze_ratchet.py as pre-existing on a pristine HEAD worktree. They were neither pre-existing nor failures.
corrections.cause: pytest was run without LUCID_ROOT set, so gear_sonic/research/practice_utility/paths.py fell back to DEFAULT_LUCID_ROOT = /data/robotixx/lucid-sonic, which does not exist on this host. The pristine-worktree check that appeared to confirm the failures inherited the same missing variable, so it confirmed the environment fault rather than ruling it out.
corrections.corrected_status: With LUCID_ROOT=/home/linjiw/lucid-sonic as env/lucid_env.sh exports, the suite is 1635 passed, 0 failed.
corrections.consequence_for_phase_2: None for the design. Operationally it matters: any driver or analysis invoked without sourcing env/lucid_env.sh will silently resolve manifests, artifacts, outputs and pools under a non-existent root.

corrections.target: design.max_delay (was 14), arms.gate_150.probe_max (was 2.0), and the probe's maximum applied intensity
corrections.defect: The probe stratum was allowed to sit one step above the frontier without a ceiling, so a gate or ramp arm at frontier 1.5 would apply lambda 1.625 in its probe cohort. fixed_150 and fixed_u150 top out at 1.5. The expansion arms would therefore have trained on strictly MORE support than the arms they are compared against, and a win would have been confounded with a support difference -- the same class of error as reading the ratchet's difficulty increase as a method effect.
corrections.discovered_by: a dry run of the full five-arm launch, which fixed_u150's frozen delay contract refused at --max-delay 14
corrections.correction: The probe is capped at the frontier ceiling: gate_probe_max = 1.5 for both expansion arms. Maximum applied intensity is now exactly 1.5 for all four 1.5 arms. At the ceiling the probe stratum becomes a second frontier stratum, which is harmless because the gate has stopped expanding. --max-delay for the campaign changes from 14 to 12, which is also fixed_u150's frozen requirement.
corrections.note: Filed before any Phase-2 policy was trained. No endpoint, threshold, decision rule or prediction changes; the comparison becomes cleaner, not easier.
